attribute_information.Chew_rate_per_min: Chewing frequency is expressed as chews per minute during consumption
attribute_information.Consumption_time: Total time from first bite to swallow for the sample
attribute_information.D50: Median particle size of almonds particles
attribute_information.Eating_rate: Rate of consumption calculated from mass and consumption time
attribute_information.Number_of_chews: Total count of chewing cycles observed during consumption of the sample
attribute_information.Number_of_particles: Count of particles quantified in particle analysis for the sample
attribute_information.Number_of_swallows: Total count of swallows observed during consumption of the sample
attribute_information.Panellist_ID: Pseudonymized unique ID for each panellist (no direct personal identifiers)
attribute_information.Particles_size: Particle size metric used in analysis
attribute_information.Saliva_incorporation: Amount of saliva incorporated into bolus as measured for the sample
attribute_information.Sample_code: Code used to blind/identify the product sample
attribute_information.Sample_mass: Mass of the food sample portion provided
attribute_information.Swallow_rate_per_min: Swallowing frequency expressed as swallows per minute during consumption

meta.description: This schema describes a tabular dataset used to examine relationships between oral processing behaviour, sensory perception, and bolus properties for chocolate matrices containing embedded almonds. Each record represents one observation per panellist per sample (panellist ID). Variables include sample information (sample mass, sample code, sample name), oral processing metrics (consumption time, number of chews, number of swallows, eating rate, chew rate per min, swallow rate per min), and bolus/particle characteristics (D50, number of particles, particle size, saliva incorporation).
meta.name: Relationships among oral processing behaviour, sensory perception, and bolus properties of embedded almonds in chocolate matrices
